thread:
deploybot: [SEC-GATE] RC-3.14.0 (sha256:ff12aa34...) failed SBOM license scan (1 WARN: ambiguous license for dep 'libx') and missing provenance.attestation. Blocking promotion to prod change window.

sophia: Noted. This is the eu->global rollout planned for tonight's change window. We need a fast decision: (A) accept SBOM WARN + cosign attestation for canary only, (B) pin prod to rc-3.13.2, or (C) delay entire change window.

taylor: Quick context: the `libx` dependency is a tiny runtime helper, previous releases had same warning but it was flagged as noise. The new SBOM tooling bumped severity to WARN. I can open an upstream license clarification PR but it won't be resolved within the window.

security: From sec side: we can allow a scoped canary if 1) cosign attestation present, 2) canary limited to 50 hosts, 20m, and 3) release notes include the approved risk rationale. For prod we require either license clarification or a documented exception approved by legal.

legal-bot: Legal: we will not approve a prod exception for ambiguous license without evidence of upstream license text or a license scan diff. For staging/canary only, legal approves a timeboxed carveout if security documents mitigations.

release-coordinator: Proposal: Start eu-staging canary with rc-3.14.0 (cosign attested) for 20m/50 hosts; pin prod to rc-3.13.2 (sha256:aa99bb88). Add release note: "Canary carveout: SBOM WARN accepted for staging only; prod blocked pending license clarification." I'll also add a watch task to revisit at global change window +48h.

sophia: Sounds good. Command to enact: `@deploybot override-evidence --artifact rc-3.14.0 --reason "staging carveout" --scope staging --duration 20m --hosts 50`.

deploybot: Received override request from sophia. Policy: SBOM_WARN + provenance missing -> manual approval chain required. React with :ok_hand: to approve staging carveout. Reply with `pin` to pin prod to previous digest instead.

taylor: :ok_hand: approving staging carveout. Also noting I'll open the upstream issue and link in the release ticket (#4278).

release-coordinator: Pinned prod to rc-3.13.2 (sha256:aa99bb88) in `release-config` (PR #1402). Staging canary starting: rc-3.14.0 (attested) to eu-staging, 20m.

security: Added extra anomaly thresholds for the canary: dependency-failure-rate, error-500 spikes, and SBOM divergence alerts to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Canary started. Monitoring hooks active. Incident window: 20m starting now.

sophia: Adding release-note entry and tagging engineering docs team to capture the temporary carveout. We'll only escalate to legal if we see behavioral regressions or license evidence surfaces.

legal-bot: Logged carveout approval in compliance tracker (ticket COM-889). Reminder: this is temporary and must not be used as precedent.

release-coordinator: Follow-ups: (1) Taylor opens upstream license PR and links it to ticket #4278, (2) Security drafts mitigation notes for release docs, (3) Sophia to schedule prod decision for next global change window. Closing thread unless any objections.

sophia: No objections. Thanks all :rocket:
